Name: Perfection Shortcut
Author: yadm18
Description:
[heading]Open the perfection tracker from your inventory[/heading]

Once Qi's Walnut Room is unlocked, a gold star button appears on the inventory screen. Click it and the inventory closes. The game then opens the same perfection letter you get from the cat in that room.

The letter uses the game's own words, in the language you play in. It lists:

[list]
[*]Items shipped[/*]
[*]Obelisks[/*]
[*]Gold Clock[/*]
[*]Monster Slayer[/*]
[*]Great Friends[/*]
[*]Farmer level[/*]
[*]Stardrops[/*]
[*]Cooking[/*]
[*]Crafting[/*]
[*]Fish[/*]
[*]Golden Walnuts[/*]
[*]Your total[/*]
[/list]
It shows the same progress as the room, and it does not change your score. In multiplayer, each line still names the farmer with the best score.

At 100%, collect the Statue of True Perfection from the cat in Qi's Walnut Room. The button keeps opening the letter.

[heading]Install Easy Access Buttons with this mod[/heading]

This version adds the star to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53328]Easy Access Buttons[/url]. Install that mod with this one. The star joins its column and lines up with the Community Center button, Organize, and the other mods that want the same inventory spot. Reorder or hide it from the gear menu there. That shared column is what this version is made for.

[line]
[size=4][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53328]Easy Access Buttons[/url][/b][/size]
by Yadm

One column for the inventory buttons that would otherwise cover each other. Perfection Shortcut joins that column on its own.
[line]

Without Easy Access Buttons, the star keeps its old spot. It sits one slot to the right of the Community Center button, and it stays there when that button is hidden. On a narrow window, where that spot would leave the screen, the star moves below the trash can. Other mods that want that same spot can cover it there.

[heading]The button[/heading]

The tooltip is "Perfection Shortcut". A tooltip from an item in the bag draws over the star.

It is hidden before the Walnut Room unlocks, while you are holding an item, and while the option below is off.

[heading]Turn it off[/heading]

The button starts on.

With [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], open Perfection Shortcut and uncheck "Show the perfection shortcut in inventory". The change applies immediately.

Without that menu, edit Mods/PerfectionShortcut/config.json after the first launch and set Enabled to false.

[heading]Install[/heading]

[list]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Unzip this download into Stardew Valley/Mods, or install the zip with Vortex.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Install Easy Access Buttons the same way.[/*]
[/list]
The mod folder should look like this:

[code]
Mods/PerfectionShortcut/PerfectionShortcut.dll
Mods/PerfectionShortcut/manifest.json
Mods/PerfectionShortcut/i18n/default.json[/code]
[heading]Requirements[/heading]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.14 or later[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.1.0 or later[/*]
[*]Install Easy Access Buttons with this mod. Perfection Shortcut still loads on its own, and the star then keeps its old spot.[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu is optional. It only adds the in-game checkbox.[/*]
[/list]
[heading]More from Yadm[/heading]

[line]
[size=4][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53092]Guild Kill List[/url][/b][/size]

Adds the monster eradication list to your inventory. After you reach floor 100 of the Mines, Marlon writes. Visit the guild and he adds the list. It joins the Easy Access Buttons column on its own. Each mod loads without the other.
[line]
